title: Monitoring One Channel Is Not Communication Control: Causal Evidence for Adaptive Reallocation of Joint Message--Route Codes
abstract: arXiv:2611.12959v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Monitoring a visible channel can change how learned agents communicate without removing why communication is useful. We test this distinction in an end-to-end game where a sender and receiver learn a discrete protocol and route policy without communication supervision. In two independent 20-seed batches, 20/20 and 19/20 protocols form. Online partial coverage increases shadow-route share over no monitoring by .701 [.574,.826] and .575 [.412,.737], while task accuracy remains .905/.913 and signed frozen message contribution remains .592/.563. Complete coverage removes most selective migration without removing communication. Frozen interventions, including a fresh pre-outcome confirmation, show that route is semantic: joint message--route shuffling changes .668 of receiver predictions and route alone retains .388 accuracy versus .25 chance. A corrected explicit-silence cost makes 18/20 policies fully silent and lowers mean sending to .050,

translated_title: 监控单一通道并非通信控制：联合消息-路由编码自适应重新分配的因果证据
translated_abstract: 监控一个可见通道可以改变学习智能体的通信方式，而不会消除通信本身的有用性。我们在一个端到端游戏中检验了这一区别，其中发送方和接收方在没有通信监督的情况下学习离散协议和路由策略。在两个独立的20随机种子批次中，分别有20/20和19/20的协议形成。在线部分覆盖相比无监控使影子路由份额增加了0.701 [0.574, 0.826]和0.575 [0.412, 0.737]，同时任务准确率保持在0.905/0.913，带符号的冻结消息贡献保持在0.592/0.563。完全覆盖消除了大部分选择性迁移，但没有消除通信本身。冻结干预（包括一个在结果产生前的新鲜确认干预）表明路由是具有语义性的：联合消息-路由打乱改变了0.668的接收方预测，而仅路由仍保留了0.388的准确率（随机水平为0.25）。修正后的显式沉默成本使18/20的策略完全沉默，并将平均发送率降至0.050。
tldr: 本研究通过端到端游戏的因果干预实验证明，监控单一通信通道会促使学习智能体将联合消息-路由编码自适应地重新分配到未受监控的路由上，而不是消除通信本身，且路由具有语义功能。
en_tdlr: Causal intervention experiments in end-to-end games demonstrate that monitoring a single communication channel leads learning agents to adaptively reallocate joint message-route codes to unmonitored routes rather than eliminating communication, and that routes carry semantic meaning.
